entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You guys see the news about[n]Madarame!? It's just like what[n]happened with Kamoshida!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And they mentioned the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, this is startin' to get interesting...[n]If we do it right, we can change people's[n]hearts.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: With this power... we might be able to[n]do more than just gettin' back at society.[n]It'll be a big deal!
This'll be fun.
I don't know...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's keep pushin' on then!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, you're so indifferent.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then again, doesn't that make him more[n]trustworthy as our leader?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: As for me, I hope we just keep gettin'[n]more and more famous!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Something like this happening twice is[n]massive too. It's too great a coincidence[n]to occur normally.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If we continue doing this, we'll definitely[n]be able to give courage to everyone[n]who needs it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...We may want to quiet down a little.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you know them?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You moron! Those're attendance officers!

entries.speaker: Officer with Sunglasses
entries.en: Hello there. May I speak with you[n]for a moment?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ah, yes! How can we help you?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That monotonous acting of hers never[n]fails to send a chill down my spine.

entries.speaker: Officer with Sunglasses
entries.en: What are you all doing here?[n]Are you friends?
We wanted some tea...
We're delinquents.
What do we look like?

entries.speaker: Stern Officer
entries.en: Hm, is that so? And how would you[n]do that in a place like this?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We were just discussing where we[n]should go...

entries.speaker: Stern Officer
entries.en: Hm? What did you say?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A-Ahaha! Th-That was a joke! He didn't[n]get much sleep last night.

entries.speaker: Officer with Sunglasses
entries.en: Well, all right. Just make sure you disperse[n]before it gets too late, okay?

entries.speaker: Officer with Sunglasses
entries.en: There have been some odd happenings[n]lately, and the news about that artist has[n]caused quite the stir.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'll be careful!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's still light out... Man, those guys must[n]have way too much time on their hands.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, don't go making stuff up on the spot[n]like that, okay!? I totally panicked 'cause[n]of you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...From now on, we'll need to be even[n]more cautious than before.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look at us! Right after the second[n]Thieves incident, both prior victims[n]are meeting up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, you mean people might be[n]listening to us?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, it'll be fine. Look around. We're[n]the only people worryin' about it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess you're right...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, Yusuke... You able to get[n]anything out of Madarame?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Remember how he was talkin' about[n]that suspicious person in the black mask?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well... I pressed him for answers, but[n]he doesn't even understand what[n]happened to him to begin with.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's not like he actually saw his desires[n]get stolen, after all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's rumored that he may be sent to[n]prison. In that case, gaining information[n]will be difficult...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, what're you gonna do now?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll be leaving that house. I can't draw[n]in such a place anymore.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you have somewhere to go?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The school dorms. I can stay there free of[n]charge thanks to my fine arts scholarship.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A scholarship!? Wait, you're that good?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Although, Takamaki-san's house would[n]do as well.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Wait, WHAT!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You know, you could ask her to model[n]for you whenever you wanted!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You moron!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then again, now that Yusuke'll be livin'[n]alone, it'll be easier for us to meet up[n]whenever we want.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: For the time being, we should wait[n]and see how this case plays out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And it'll prolly take some time findin'[n]a target as big as Madarame.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, we should just act like normal[n]students while we look for our next target,[n]okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll be entrusting that to you again,[n]Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right. Guess it's just more prep[n]'til then.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yusuke Kitagawa...
